dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You know what, I dreamed about you last night. In that giấc mơ, we were walking along the Sài Gòn river and having a really pleasant conversation.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: What a trùng hợp! I also dreamed about you last night. But in my giấc mơ, we were sitting in my room and... oh actually I don't remember

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: How can there be such a strange trùng hợp? I find it a bit weird...

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I don't believe in fate, but this trùng hợp is interesting. How about we try going for a walk along the Sài Gòn river like in your giấc mơ and see what happens?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's a good idea! But why the Sài Gòn riverbank and not at your place in your giấc mơ?
